hero.title: Put a QR on the table, the menu opens on the phone.
hero.subtitle: Enter your products, pick a theme, put the QR code on the table. The customer scans it and the menu opens instantly on their phone. When a price changes, update it in one place; printing costs and outdated menus become a thing of the past.

items.q: Does the customer need to download an app?
items.a: No. Scanning the QR with the phone camera is enough; the menu opens directly in the browser. No app is installed, no account is required.

items.q: Do I need to reprint the QR when the price changes?
items.a: No. The QR always points to the same link; once you update the content, the customer sees the current menu automatically the next time they scan it.
The customer's phone needs internet to open the menu; mobile data is more than enough. For venues with weak signal, we recommend leaving a short Wi-Fi note on the table.

items.q: How many products can I add?
items.a: On the trial plan you can set up and preview your menu and download your QR. On the Pro plan there is no limit on the number of products or categories.

items.q: Can I add my own logo and colors?
items.a: On the Pro plan you can add your logo and pick the look that fits your venue best from six ready-made themes.
